newsitem.title: CANADA: Prudential Steel soars on stock split news.
newsitem.headline: Prudential Steel soars on stock split news.

text.p: Prudential Steel Ltd shares soared on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Tuesday after the company reported better than expected second-quarter earnings and announced a 3-for-1 stock split.
Analysts said a booming oil and gas sector kept the company's production of its Oil Country Tubular Goods and Line Pipe going flat out for the first six months of this year.

"First of all they reported second-quarter results and they were very, very strong," said Greg Misztela, head of research at Griffiths McBurney in Toronto. "The oil and gas sector is extremely strong and basically they have been operating flat out and the pricing environment for them has been very strong as well."

Prudential shares jumped 5.75 to 53 by midday today after the company said its second-quarter earnings jumped 256 percent to C$8.31 million or C$0.82 a share from year earlier C$2.34 million or C$0.23 a share. It added that it planned a 3-for-1 stock split, subject to shareholder approval in October.

Misztela said the pricing and demand environment for Prudential was so strong that he increased his earnings estimate for the third quarter and raised his target price to C$63 for the 12-month period after the stock split.
